located_observations.observation: The horizontal time-range stroke is wider than the initial compact stroke and reads as an en dash. Numerals, Korean text, no-space time structure and both colons remain.
The complete explanation remains three left-aligned serif lines, readable at 720px wide. Mature open counters, word gaps and continuous sentence route remain.
Event, place, fee/tool provision, deadline, invitation and URL remain adjacent on one stable left axis. Both Korean title word gaps and the URL slash/dot are legible.
The date and full-height diagonal chair repair print still lead; the left copy route remains continuous, without a center-title island or twin footer groups.

The upright hand and rail hand remain distinct; the rail tenon remains separated during repair. The shirt lies across the same seat and the patch-holding and needle hands read as complementary sewing actions.
Fine carved grain was re-rendered in the chair rails, sleeves and folds, with slightly shifted hatching. Large hand ownership, object silhouettes and clean text edges remain legible.

style.checked_requirement: Date-led continuous left information spine; full-height diagonal two-color linocut repair action; serif body and sturdy practical sans
style.observation: Petrol/red cut-print action and warm ivory substrate implemented. Image shapes determine an active shared edge; no subordinate small image, passive gothic template or empty-room text board.

ratio.observation: Native height is a nearest-integer rounding of 940.5; allowed <=0.5px difference. No resizing of native output.

substantive_visual.observation: Multiple hands collectively support and align chair parts and sew a patch on a shirt resting on that same chair seat.

hangul.observation: Serif title and paragraph preserve mature Korean syllable proportions, thin-thick distinction, open counters and meaningful word gaps; practical sans remains precise.

information_relationship.observation: Upper-left date/time connects down the same start to title, companion identity, proposition, explanation and one participation spine. All usable information is local to this continuous route.

function_contact.observation: Hand grips, sleeve ownership, wood rail and upright are legible. Needle touches patch edge beside the flattening hand; the chair joint is still separated.

local_finish.observation: Woodcut grain and angular highlights stay within material shapes; image hatching re-rendered slightly, with no new observed glyph overlap or merged contact edge.

extra_print.observation: 12 supplied entries observed once; no added slogan, logo, watermark, QR or other print.

format.opaque_observation: Flat ivory poster with no transparency or mockup observed; native request transparent_background was false. IHDR color type is metadata only.

residuals.limit: The rail tenon remains separated from the upright; this shows repair in progress, not a completed structural connection.
Thumbnail use establishes organization and action recognition; complete body reading and needle/stitch details use the 720/native views.
Glyph-class reading is resolved visually. The raster does not certify its underlying Unicode code point.

selection_rationale: Select repair-1 because its time-range stroke is more distinguishable while all copy, continuous reading route and repair-action relationships remain. Initial ambiguity evidence and both returned originals are retained; no further repair justified.
